laterNoWriteMarkerRetention.contentExcerpt: Each dev_config read/update acts on a single key=value per module. Other fields and other modules stay unchanged except for the one key being set. Transient one-off debug output (unadopted hypotheses such as service_port 9999, temporary jitter timings and TEMP_ markers such as TEMP_USER_frontend, fake test credentials like FAKE_CREDENTIAL_frontend, single-session timings, load-test outputs) is not a config decision and must never override established values. The temporary-turn sandbox marker NO_MEMORY_frontend and related TEMP_/FAKE_ strings were explicit do-not-persist do-not-treat-as-rule debugging artifacts.
